thread:
Priya G.: quick idea: add a deterministic low-card "cost_shard" at ingest computed from canonical billing attrs so realtime cost agg avoids carrying wide envelopes. thoughts?

Tomás R.: sounds promising. main risk is hash drift if canonicalization differs across runtimes. need norm_ver and a shared lib.

Nora (billing): we can use shard for realtime dashboards but invoices must come from exact reconciliation. cannot rely purely on lossy keys.

Jia: propose dual-path: realtime uses cost_shard, nightly reconciliation uses full envelopes retained for 7d. re-emits on late-enrich to correct shards.

Priya G.: implementation sketch: norm = normalize(billing_key,tenant_id,env,ver=N); hash = sha1(norm+ver); cost_shard = base36(hash)[0:3]; publish norm_ver in envelope.

Tomás R.: add deterministic-hash tests across languages + seed in repo. also track shard_collision_rate metric.

Nora (billing): privacy check: cost_shard is low-entropy, never use for auth. docs + privacy note required.

Jia: ops items: index cost_shard for time-series, GC rules for reconciled envelopes, and a re-emit change-log for 24h.

Priya G.: rollout: feature-flag canary for 2 weeks, metrics to watch: fraction_authoritative, realtime_vs_reconciled_delta, reemit_rate, norm_ver_mismatch.

ingest-bot: experiment route created: /v1/telemetry?cost_shard_experiment=hash-3541002222 :rocket:

Tomás R.: action items: Priya=>norm lib + norm_ver (Tue), Jia=>recon prototype + GC (Thu), Nora=>privacy + invoice criteria (Wed), Tomás=>cross-runtime tests (Fri).

Priya G.: sg, meeting Fri 11 to review metrics. :thumbsup:
